title: ω₁ Properties: Aleph Hierarchy, Regularity, and Cofinality
description: Structural properties of ω₁ = (ℵ₁).ord: aleph hierarchy ℵ_α < ℵ_(α+1), regularity of ℵ₁, uncountable cofinality, and ordinal characterizations.

meta.author: Cantor (1895), Hausdorff (1908), formalized in Lean 4 with Mathlib
originalContributions: Aleph hierarchy: ℵ_α < ℵ_(α+1) for all ordinals α
ℵ₁ regularity and cofinality = ℵ₁ (uncountable cofinality)
Countable cardinal characterization: κ < ℵ₁ ↔ κ ≤ ℵ₀

references.title: Beiträge zur Begründung der transfiniten Mengenlehre
Grundzüge einer Theorie der geordneten Mengen

sections.title: Aleph Hierarchy
sections.summary: Strict monotonicity: ℵ_α < ℵ_(α+1) for all α. Injectivity of the aleph function.

sections.title: Cofinality and Regularity
sections.summary: ℵ₁ is regular, cof(ω₁) = ℵ₁, uncountable cofinality.

sections.title: Cardinal Properties
sections.summary: ℵ₁ = succ(ℵ₀), κ < ℵ₁ ↔ κ ≤ ℵ₀, countable cardinal characterization.

sections.title: Ordinal of ℵ₁
sections.summary: card((ℵ₁).ord) = ℵ₁, ω < ω₁, α < ω₁ ↔ countable, ω₁ not countable.

conclusion.summary: 14 theorems proved with 0 sorries and 0 axioms, completing the structural characterization of ω₁.
conclusion.implications: Provides a complete formal foundation for first uncountable ordinal properties, enabling further set-theoretic constructions in Lean 4.
openQuestions: Can the generalized Hartogs theorem (for any infinite cardinal κ, the set of ordinals of cardinality < κ has cardinality κ) be formalized?
Can König's theorem (cof(ℵ_ω) > ℵ₀) be proved for singular cardinals?
